HEADSSS Guide Question.description: With whom do you live? Describe your home situation.
Are there any problems within your family that directly or indirectly concerns you?
How are things for you at school/work? Are you having failures or problems?
How is your relationship with teachers, fellow classmates or employees?
On a normal day, how many meals do you have? What do you eat?
Has somebody pointed out that you have gained weight or lost weight?
What do you do in your free time? Whom do you spend your time with?
Do you participate in sports activities in school or community or exercise regularly?
Have you ever used tobacco/vape? Alcohol? Other substances?
If YES, are you using them currently? How much? How heavily?
Have you ever had sex, if yes, are you sexually active now?
Do you protect yourself from infection or becoming pregnant or getting someone pregnant? Were you forced to have sex?
Are you stressed? Sad or depressed in any way? Feeling anxious
Have you ever thought of hurting yourself or ending your life?
Do you feel safe at home? At work? At school? In your neighborhood?
Do you wear a seatbelt when riding a car? A helmet when riding a motorbike?
